scope: Issue #1 follow-up: first real local LTX clips (t2v + i2v) and playhead image-to-video. Not full issue acceptance.

worker.config: Lightricks/LTX-Video-0.9.5 @ e58e28c39631af4d1468ee57a853764e11c1d37e (model_index, scheduler, transformer, vae JSON only)
worker.preset: bf16, T5 on CPU then freed, model CPU offload, tiled VAE, 8 uniform steps, guidance 1, seed 42

failedAttempts.cause: worker rechecked a hard 9 GiB on torch free memory after its own CUDA context (9309 MiB nvidia-smi -> 9053 MiB torch) and refused a run the bridge had admitted
failedAttempts.fix: 512 MiB context allowance against the provider's minimumFreeMiB

failedAttempts.cause: single-file checkpoint contains no T5 weights; from_single_file raised SingleFileComponentError
failedAttempts.fix: load T5EncoderModel/T5TokenizerFast from base/, encode on CPU in bf16, free before diffusion

failedAttempts.cause: 0.9.0 base VAE config cannot load 0.9.6 VAE (decoder.conv_in 512 vs 1024)

failedAttempts.result: failed after 1132 s (T5 load thrashed swap while host RAM was ~1 GB available)
failedAttempts.cause: diffusers 0.35 LTXPipeline always passes sigmas; custom timesteps raise ValueError

failedAttempts.result: generation-failed at progress 0.2375 after 245 s; peak worker 4622 MiB
failedAttempts.cause: CPU prompt embeddings not moved to CUDA under model offload (traceback reproduced in debug harness)
another process briefly held VRAM at start; worker refused correctly, no inference
LTXImageToVideoPipeline draws decode noise on CUDA; CPU generator rejected
failedAttempts.fix: CUDA generator for i2v only (t2v receipt unchanged)

t2v.command: FFS_GEN_SMOKE_SIZE=480x480 FFS_GEN_SMOKE_SECONDS=2 npm run gen:smoke (through GenerationQueue: ffprobe + full -xerror decode validation)
t2v.visual: Coherent orange ceramic teapot on wood with rising steam; little camera motion. Second direct-harness run (shorter prompt) also coherent.

i2v.command: FFS_GEN_SMOKE_REFERENCE=<480x480 PNG> FFS_GEN_SMOKE_SIZE=480x480 FFS_GEN_SMOKE_SECONDS=2 npm run gen:smoke (reference stored via GenerationQueue.addReference)
i2v.reference: first frame of a prior real t2v run; sha256 f97a0f77649b35054d8a8a15f50301254392e7916a40f01d08d8de668d6888db
i2v.visual: Follows the reference closely (same teapot, framing, wood); nearly static: low motion at 8 steps.

realModel.artifacts: Kept outside Git in the external genworker artifacts directory (smoke-20261020-*), including every failed attempt's samples.
realModel.interpretation: One run per mode at 480x480/2 s. Prompt encoding on CPU dominates latency and depends on shared host RAM pressure (the same phase took ~17 min in a swap-bound run). 704x480 and 5 s are NOT measured; the 9216 MiB admission threshold is kept unchanged. Not a quality or throughput benchmark.
